implementation_state: ARCHITECTURE ONLY - nothing described here is implemented by this task

legend.target: EXISTING (reuse) | EXTEND (column/constraint on an existing table) | NEW (new domain entity required)

canonical_result_dimension.rationale: A Scope 2 emissions number is meaningless without its accounting method. GHG Protocol requires dual reporting: the same electricity activity must be able to carry a location-based AND a market-based result without either overwriting the other. This is the single most important Scope 2 integrity dimension, so it is a REQUIRED dimension on every Scope 2 result rather than a free-text attribute.
canonical_result_dimension.current_evidence: Vocabulary exists only in backend/domain/disclosure.py:145 (SCOPE2_METHODS = ('LOCATION_BASED','MARKET_BASED')) and the disclosure CHECK at supabase/migrations/20260914000000_p8_b1_disclosure_model_foundation.sql:132 (scope2_method_hint). No calculation or emissions row carries a method.
canonical_result_dimension.constraint: CHECK (scope2_method IS NULL OR scope2_method IN ('LOCATION_BASED','MARKET_BASED')) - reuses the frozen B1 vocabulary verbatim; no new vocabulary is introduced
canonical_result_dimension.scope_rule: CHECK (scope <> 'Scope 2' OR scope2_method IS NOT NULL) added NOT VALID so historical rows are never rewritten while every new Scope 2 write must carry a method

fields.purpose: Tenant boundary for the activity and every derived result.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.organization_id (NOT NULL, FK organizations), calculation_snapshots.organization_id (NOT NULL, FK organizations)
fields.note: RLS is already enabled on both tables; the Scope 2 entity set must add no un-scoped table.

fields.purpose: Consumption period, distinct from the factor year.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.start_date/end_date (NOT NULL); calculation_snapshots.date + reporting_year
fields.note: Activity period must never be conflated with factor year (see factor governance).

fields.purpose: Site/meter attribution; required when the organisation operates more than one site, or when the supplier/meter is site-specific, because grid location and MPAN are site properties.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.metadata->>'facility_id' (backend/data/emissions_logs.py:221 _log_metadata); calculation_snapshots has no facility dimension at all
fields.reference_data: facilities exists with country, region, postcode, latitude, longitude, meter_mpan_mprn
fields.note: JSONB-only facility attribution is not indexable, not FK-constrained and not RLS-checkable; P17 requires a real column with FK facilities(id) for the Scope 2 site dimension.

fields.purpose: Distinguishes electricity / heat / steam / cooling, which select different factor families and different instrument rules.
fields.current_location: Only inferable from emission_factors.activity_type family ('UK electricity', 'Heat and steam', 'Fuels')
fields.note: AUTHORITATIVE Scope 2 energy-type vocabulary (ARCH-04 // ARCH-03 LOW-02): exactly four values - electricity | heat | steam | cooling. 'fuel' is NOT a Scope 2 energy type and is deliberately absent from this vocabulary; fuel-borne energy is a Scope 1 or Scope 3 activity identified by the activity/factor, and a Scope 1/Scope 3 row carries energy_type = NULL. The vocabulary is carried on the activity and is never inferred from free text at calculation time. Live inventory: 346 electricity / 8 heat / 8 steam / 0 cooling factors, so 'cooling' must resolve to controlled review, not a guess.

fields.purpose: The activity quantity to which the factor applies.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.raw_quantity, calculation_snapshots.quantity

fields.purpose: Unit of the activity; must match the factor unit exactly (a mismatch is a hard error today).
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.unit (FK units.code), calculation_snapshots.quantity_unit
fields.note: Factor units are qualified, e.g. 'kWh (Net CV)'. Central normalisation lives in backend/core/units.py; P17 must reuse it and must not duplicate alias logic.

fields.purpose: The grid region whose location-based factor applies. Required for LOCATION_BASED; not required for MARKET_BASED when a valid contractual instrument supplies the market factor.
fields.current_location: No column. The factor carries country only (GB/IE); no region/grid-resolution dimension exists on the activity.
fields.reference_data: facilities.region / country / latitude / longitude exist and are the natural resolution source
fields.note: Location-based acceptance requires an explicit resolved grid location, or an explicit recorded reason why national (country) resolution was used. Silent fallback to a national factor when a regional factor is required must be a controlled review state.

fields.purpose: Jurisdiction for factor eligibility.
fields.current_location: emission_factors.country (GB 7029 / IE 20); facilities.country

fields.purpose: The grid/location emission factor used by the location-based method.
fields.current_location: emission_factors.id, referenced by calculation_snapshots.factor_id (ON DELETE RESTRICT) with factor_kind='emission_factor'

fields.purpose: Provenance of the location factor (authority and set vintage).
fields.current_location: emission_factors.factor_source ('DEFRA-DESNZ'), factor_set ('DEFRA-2025'); copied onto calculation_snapshots.factor_source/factor_set

fields.purpose: The factor's reporting year, governed explicitly, never silently substituted.
fields.current_location: emission_factors.reporting_year (2025 only in the live inventory); copied into calculation_snapshots.reporting_year
fields.known_gap: Four production call sites present cross-year candidate sets to an operator because they omit the year filter: backend/api/v3_operations.py:1039, backend/api/v3_operations.py:1650, backend/api/v3_processing_workflow.py:1156, backend/services/automatic_processing.py:1615 (all call repos.factors.find_by_activity(...) without year=). data/emission_factors.py:173 then orders by reporting_year DESC. Latent today (7049/7049 factors are 2025); harmful the moment a second factor year is imported. P17-A must close this.

fields.purpose: The supplier/contractual emission factor used by the market-based method.
fields.current_location: No distinction exists; any emission_factors row could be used for either method today, which is exactly the confusion the method dimension removes.
fields.note: Market factors must be identifiable as such (governed factor classification, supplier-specific factor, or instrument-derived factor).

fields.purpose: Provenance of the market factor (supplier disclosure, supplier-specific factor, or instrument-implied rate).
Year governance for the market factor; the same no-silent-fallback rule as location factors.
The energy supplier / instrument issuer / provider, for supplier attribution and supplier-specific factors.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.supplier_id (FK suppliers); 25 of 34 live emissions rows carry it after the P16 wave
fields.related: backend/engines/supplier_resolution.py (org-scoped, fail-closed: exact | unresolved | confirm_creation | ambiguous)
fields.note: P17 extends supplier attribution to Scope 2 providers and instrument issuers WITHOUT creating a parallel supplier model and without weakening org scoping.

fields.purpose: The claimable instrument backing a market-based result. Required when the market-based result relies on an instrument rather than a supplier factor.
fields.current_location: No contractual-instrument entity exists anywhere in the schema (verified against 141 public tables: no instrument/claim/allocation table; the only instrument-like columns are disclosure scope2_method_hint)
fields.note: This is the unavoidable new domain entity for Scope 2 market-based accounting.

fields.purpose: Controlled vocabulary distinguishing instrument classes that carry different evidentiary and validity rules.
fields.note: Deliberately generic; jurisdiction-specific classes (e.g. UK REGO, US REC) map onto it and their rule sets are FRAMEWORK-SPECIFIC / DEFERRED.

fields.purpose: The certificate/contract serial or identifier, so a claim is addressable and cannot be duplicated.
Quantity of energy the instrument represents, in its own unit.
Unit of the instrument quantity; must be reconcilable with the consumption unit for allocation.
Generation/validity period of the instrument.
Market/geography the instrument is valid in. An instrument valid in one market cannot silently back consumption in another.
Generation vintage year, which may differ from the reporting year; the difference is a validity input, not a silent substitution.
Who owns/claims the environmental attribute; needed to prohibit the same attribute being claimed twice, including twice by one organisation.
fields.canonical_terminology: claimant_organization_id is the CONCEPTUAL name for the organisation that claims the instrument (ARCH-04 // ARCH-03 LOW-01). Its proposed PHYSICAL column on contractual_instruments is organization_id, kept so the table follows the uniform P17 tenant/RLS convention; the two are one-to-one. See schema delta s10.6.
fields.note: The claimant organisation is the tenant key: a second organisation claiming the same instrument must be structurally impossible, not merely discouraged.

fields.purpose: The binding of (part of) an instrument to a specific activity/period. Market-based accounting is an allocation act and must be recorded as one.
invariants: sum(allocations for an instrument) <= instrument_quantity (per unit, normalised)
an allocation belongs to exactly one organisation and one reporting period
an allocation references the source activity/snapshot it supports
allocated quantity cannot exceed the eligible consumption of that activity/period

fields.purpose: Residual-mix factor for market-based accounting where the market requires it.
fields.current_location: No residual-mix factor set exists in emission_factors (factor sources are DEFRA-DESNZ/DEFRA-2025 and SEAI/2025 only)
fields.note: Residual mix cannot be implemented by inventing a factor value. Where a market requires residual mix and none is available, the market-based result must be blocked into controlled review rather than silently computed from a location factor.

fields.purpose: Source evidence for the activity, the factor selection, the instrument and the allocation.
fields.current_location: evidence_line_items (67 live rows: source_item_id, line_number, source_page, row_reference, raw_description, raw_quantity, raw_unit, payload_hash, extraction_method, materialisation_kind); disclosure_value_evidence links values to snapshots/logs
fields.note: An instrument-based market claim must carry its own evidence document; it may not rely on the activity's evidence alone.

fields.purpose: Traceability chain from report value back to source.
fields.current_location: calculation_snapshots.source_item_id, source_line_item_id, source_file, source_page, performed_by, content_hash, algorithm_version; emissions_logs.snapshot_id

fields.purpose: The arithmetic used, machine-readable.
fields.current_location: calculation_snapshots.methodology; CalculationMethodology enum in backend/domain/calculation.py (direct_multiply, distance_based, spend_based, area_based, mass_balance)
fields.note: Scope 2 dual-method accounting must NOT be encoded by inventing location/market methodology strings. The method is the scope2_method dimension; the methodology remains the arithmetic.

fields.purpose: Immutable forensic record of the calculation.
fields.current_location: calculation_snapshots (append-only, content_hash, uq_calc_snapshots_request_id from P16-R7)

fields.purpose: The resulting kg CO2e.
fields.current_location: calculation_snapshots.co2e_kg; emissions_logs.calculated_kg_co2e

fields.purpose: Whether the result may enter a report aggregate.
fields.current_location: emissions_logs.reportability_status / calculation_snapshots.reportability_status = reportable | not_for_reporting | superseded (P16-RD-4, migration 20261008000000, with the invalidation-described CHECK)
fields.note: P17 REUSES this lifecycle and must not create an independent Scope 2/3 reportability model. Live evidence: Scope 1 6 reportable + 2 superseded; Scope 3 25 reportable + 1 not_for_reporting.

fields.purpose: Link the location-based and market-based results of the same activity so a report presents both and neither can be mistaken for the other.
fields.derivation: Both results share the same source activity identity (source_item_id / Scope 2 activity id) and differ by scope2_method; a pairing is therefore a query, not a new stored entity.
fields.note: Storing a 'dual pair' row would duplicate accounting results and is explicitly rejected.

rejected_designs.design: A single Scope 2 emissions column overwritten when the method changes
rejected_designs.reason: Violates dual reporting; the P16 reportability lifecycle already exists to supersede a result without destroying it.

rejected_designs.design: A separate Scope 2 accounting table parallel to calculation_snapshots/emissions_logs
rejected_designs.reason: Duplicates the calculation, provenance, evidence and reportability machinery; P14-RECON-01 s19 forbids parallel systems.

rejected_designs.design: Encoding the method in the methodology string (e.g. 'location_based_multiply')
rejected_designs.reason: Conflates arithmetic with accounting method, makes the disclosure scope2_method_hint unreachable, and cannot be enforced by a CHECK constraint.

rejected_designs.design: Inferring scope2_method from factor_source or factor activity text
rejected_designs.reason: Silently reinterprets user data; the method is an operator/accounting decision and must be explicit.

open_questions_requiring_po_decision: Whether market-based reporting is delivered at P17-C with contractual instruments (REC/GO-style claims), or first with supplier-specific/residual-mix market factors only.
Whether location-based geography resolution may default to national (country) level when no regional factor exists, or must always enter controlled review.
Whether the residual-mix requirement is in scope for the first market-based delivery or deferred as FRAMEWORK_SPECIFIC.

notes: The 33-field Scope 2 domain decisions are UNCHANGED. Method identity remains REQUIRED and must not be inferred from factor metadata.
